models.story: The Awareness Story as a whole — an ordered sequence of slides plus playback configuration (default duration per slide, whether autoplay is enabled at start).
models.slide: A single slide in the story. Has a type that controls layout, a headline, optional supporting text, and slide-type-specific data (figure for stat slides, items for breakdown slides, cta for the closing slide).
models.figure: A single large statistic shown on a stat slide — a number, an optional unit, and a short caption explaining what it counts.
models.breakdownItem: One row in a breakdown slide — a category label with a count and an optional short description.
models.cta: The single call-to-action shown on the closing slide — label and href.

relationships: story has a list of slides played in order.
A stat slide has one figure.
A breakdown slide has many breakdownItem records.
A cta slide has one cta record.

slides.headline: Living Clean
slides.supportingText: A factual look at what the Lederhof leaves behind every week — and what we can do about it.

slides.headline: Every week on the Lederhof
slides.supportingText: Counted by the city's automated detection across the whole square, averaged over the last 12 weeks.

slides.headline: What gets left behind
slides.supportingText: A typical week, broken down by category.

items.label: Cigarette butts
items.description: By far the largest category. Most accumulate around the seating areas and the south entrance.

items.label: Food packaging
items.description: Wrappers, cups, takeaway containers — peaking in the early afternoon.

items.label: General waste
items.description: Tissues, receipts, small paper and plastic fragments.

items.label: Drug paraphernalia
items.description: Concentrated near the north corner; cleaned with elevated safety protocols.

slides.headline: Across a year
slides.supportingText: What the weekly number compounds to.

slides.headline: And someone picks them up
slides.supportingText: City cleaning crews log every operation. The work is real.
